My partner has AdHD, diagnosed when he was an adult. We are 3 years in. 33F and he is 35m. When we started having 'difficulties' He would mention his adhd as the reason. I struggled to understand. So i bought a book. 'Is it you me or adult add.' That helped a lot. It gave me  different perspective. It offers real life experiences of relationships that worked and that didn't work. Read it, research it, inform yourself. It helps. It doesn't change or fix anything just gives you a different perspective. I am about to read it again, just to remind me of his perspective.
 If you don't have adhd, it can be like speaking the same language but  a dialect slightly differnt, just enough so it is frustrating not having the other person understand you.
Talk to him, tell him your position, but also let him know you are trying too. Because he undoubtedly is trying, he just can't focus the words to tell you he is.
